zh.title: 老挝万象：警方集中查处电诈及非法赌博活动
zh.summary: Laotian Times报道，万象警方11月17日及20日四次执法共拘捕49名外国人，其中20日一次行动涉及21名中国籍人员。
zh.body:
Laotian Times于11月25日报道，万象警方在11月17日及20日针对涉嫌电诈及非法赌博活动开展四次执法，共拘捕49名外国人。其中20日一次行动涉及21名中国籍人员及一名韩国籍人员。拘捕属于调查阶段。
分析：执法已涉及首都经营场所，企业应将第三方招聘、办公场所租赁及外籍员工证件合规纳入审查。后续关注警方公布的案件处理、遣返安排及新增执法区域。

en.title: Laos: Vientiane police conduct coordinated telecom fraud raids
en.summary: Laotian Times reported 49 foreign nationals arrested in four raids on 17 and 20 November, including 21 Chinese nationals in one operation on 20 November.
en.body:
Laotian Times reported on 25 November that police arrested 49 foreign nationals in four operations targeting suspected telecom fraud and illegal gambling on 17 and 20 November. One operation on 20 November involved 21 Chinese nationals and one South Korean. Arrests are part of an investigation.
Assessment: Enforcement extends to business premises in the capital. Companies should review third-party recruitment, premises leases and foreign employee documentation. Track police case updates, repatriation arrangements and additional enforcement locations.
